mapper.select:
SELECT PI.inq_id, PI.product_id, PI.package_id, PI.member_id,
CASE WHEN PI.is_secret = 'N' THEN PI.inq_content WHEN PI.member_id = #{memberId} THEN PI.inq_content WHEN #{role} = 'ADMIN' THEN PI.inq_content ELSE '비밀 문의입니다.' END AS inq_content,
PI.inq_status,
CASE WHEN PI.is_secret = 'N' THEN PI.answer_content WHEN PI.member_id = #{memberId} THEN PI.answer_content WHEN #{role} = 'ADMIN' THEN PI.answer_content ELSE NULL END AS answer_content,
PI.answered_by, PI.answered_at, PI.created_at, PI.updated_at, PI.is_secret, PI.is_deleted,
CASE WHEN PI.is_secret = 'N' THEN M.member_name WHEN PI.member_id = #{memberId} THEN M.member_name WHEN #{role} = 'ADMIN' THEN M.member_name ELSE '비공개' END AS member_name,
CASE WHEN PI.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN P.product_name ELSE PK.package_name END AS product_name
FROM PRODUCT_INQ PI
JOIN MEMBER M ON PI.member_id = M.member_id
LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON PI.product_id = P.product_id
LEFT JOIN PACKAGE PK ON PI.package_id = PK.package_id
WHERE PI.is_deleted = 'N'
AND PI.product_id = #{productId}
AND PI.package_id = #{packageId}
AND PI.inq_status = #{inqStatus}
ORDER BY PI.created_at DESC, PI.inq_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_INQ ( product_id, package_id, member_id, inq_content, inq_status, is_secret, is_deleted, created_at ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{packageId}, #{memberId}, #{inqContent}, 'WAITING', #{isSecret}, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT_INQ SET answer_content = #{answerContent}, inq_status = 'ANSWERED', answered_by = #{answeredBy}, answered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE inq_id = #{inqId} AND inq_status = 'WAITING' AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE PRODUCT_INQ SET inq_content = #{inqContent}, is_secret = #{isSecret}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE inq_id = #{inqId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND inq_status = 'WAITING' AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE PRODUCT_INQ SET is_deleted = 'Y', updated_at = NOW() WHERE inq_id = #{inqId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE PRODUCT_INQ SET answer_content = #{answerContent}, answered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE inq_id = #{inqId} AND inq_status = 'ANSWERED' AND is_deleted = 'N'

UPDATE PRODUCT_INQ SET answer_content = NULL, inq_status = 'WAITING', answered_by = NULL, answered_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE inq_id = #{inqId} AND inq_status = 'ANSWERED' AND is_deleted = 'N'
